sources.note: Main website. Patient First is a large urgent care / primary care chain with ~79 locations in VA, MD, PA, NJ. Founded 1981, privately held.
About page describing founding vision, innovation in registration and treatment systems, and growth history.

ONC mandatory disclosures page. Lists certified criteria, software dependencies (Surescripts, DataMotion, Micromedex, GUDID API), EHI export categories (Medical Records/C-CDA, X-Rays/DICOM, Scanned Images, Consults/PDF, Messages/EML, Forms/PDF, Financials/JSON), and certified CQMs.

CY 2025 Real World Testing report. Confirms PAS is 'self-developed for our own clinics' and used 'exclusively in our own urgent care centers.' Contains Q1 2025 volume data: ~480K e-prescriptions, ~180K C-CDAs, ~60K portal logins, 31 EHI exports, 0 third-party FHIR apps.
Services page listing urgent care, primary care, on-site x-ray, on-site lab, on-site medications, immunizations, occupational health.
Locations page showing ~79 medical centers across VA (~21), MD (~20), PA (~18), NJ (~6).

Occupational health / employer services page. Describes workers' comp treatment, DOT physicals, drug testing, employer portal for invoices, drug screen results, medical records, and workers' comp summaries.
Telehealth services available 8am-6pm daily in VA, MD, PA, NJ for patients 12+.
Patient portal. Proprietary (not MyChart). Provides visit history, lab results, balance/payments, secure messaging. Requires in-person activation.
Portal instructions. Describes viewing lab results, transmitting records to third parties.
FAQ page with details about patient portal access, records, and services.
2019 Washington Post profile. Describes Patient First as among the top 10 largest urgent care chains, founded by former ER doctor, 74 locations at time of writing.
Wikipedia page confirming founding date, headquarters, founder, and basic organizational details.

Glassdoor reviews (3.4/5.0, ~567 reviews). Multiple employees describe the computer system as 'old' or 'outdated' with 'unique abbreviations not used in other healthcare settings.' Some positive mentions as well.
LinkedIn profile confirming 1,001-5,000 employees, headquartered in Glen Allen, VA.
Third-party revenue estimate (~$716M). Rough estimate only — Patient First is privately held.
Robert Pitt identified as VP of MIS at Patient First, part of the internal technology leadership.
Careers page confirming active hiring of Software Developers and Programmers at Glen Allen HQ, indicating in-house EHR development team.
